海水提溴：空气吹出法: Bromine from Seawater: The Air-Blowing Process
必修第二册 · 第八章第一节 · 海水资源的开发利用: Required Book 2 · Ch. 8, Sec. 1 · Developing and Using Seawater Resources
海水里的溴只有 65 mg/L，怎么把它变成一瓶液溴？: Seawater holds only 65 mg/L of bromine. How do you turn that into a bottle of liquid bromine?
酸化到 pH 3.5，抑制歧化: Acidify to pH 3.5 to suppress disproportionation
吹出 + SO₂ 吸收，浓缩 255 倍: Blow out + absorb in SO₂, concentrating 255 times
再氯化 + 蒸馏得液溴: Chlorinate again + distill to get liquid bromine
加 H₂SO₄ 把海水调到 pH 3.5: Add H₂SO₄ to bring seawater to pH 3.5
通入 Cl₂ 把 Br⁻ 氧化成 Br₂: Pass in Cl₂ to oxidize Br⁻ to Br₂
80 ℃、气水比 300:1 逆流吹出 Br₂: 80 °C, air-to-water ratio 300:1, countercurrent blowing out of Br₂
SO₂ 水溶液吸收富集，浓缩 255 倍: SO₂ solution absorbs and concentrates it 255 times
二次氯化 + 蒸馏得液溴: Second chlorination + distillation gives liquid bromine
酸化不足：Br₂ 与 Cl₂ 都会歧化，吹出率腰斩: Under-acidified: both Br₂ and Cl₂ disproportionate and the blow-out rate halves
Br⁻（−1）→ Br₂（0）：Cl₂ 是氧化剂: Br⁻ (−1) → Br₂ (0): Cl₂ is the oxidizer
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃：蒸馏分离: Br₂ boils at 58.8 °C: separated by distillation
海水里溴只有 65 mg/L，为什么不能直接把它蒸出来？: Seawater has only 65 mg/L of bromine. Why can't you just evaporate it out?
拖动视角，把五个工段看一圈: Drag the view around the five sections
参考工况在跑：溴回收率 84.2 %、液溴 54.7 kg/h: Reference setup running: bromine recovery 84.2 %, liquid bromine 54.7 kg/h
溴太稀（65 mg/L），直接蒸发整片海水不现实；工业用「氧化—吹出—吸收」先把: Bromine is too dilute (65 mg/L) to evaporate a whole sea of water; industry first concentrates it 255 times by "oxidize – blow out – absorb", then chlorinates and distills.
海水里 Br⁻ 只有 65 mg/L，1 m³ 海水里只有 65 g 溴。: Seawater holds only 65 mg/L of Br⁻: just 65 g of bromine per 1 m³.
全流程两次氯化、一次吸收：溴的价态走 −1 → 0 → −1 → 0。: Two chlorinations and one absorption in the whole process: bromine's oxidation state goes −1 → 0 → −1 → 0.
富集发生在吸收工段（浓缩 255 倍），不靠蒸馏。: Concentration happens in the absorption section (255 times), not in distillation.
去掉富集这一步：1 L 液溴要从 57 m³ 海水里拿，等于把几万吨水搬一遍。: Skip the concentration step and 1 L of liquid bromine would come from 57 m³ of seawater, like moving tens of thousands of tonnes of water.
考点：海水提溴的五个工段与它们的先后顺序。: Exam point: the five sections of bromine extraction from seawater and their order.
Br⁻ → Br₂ → HBr → Br₂ → 液溴: Br⁻ → Br₂ → HBr → Br₂ → liquid bromine
四个价态台阶：氧化—吹出—吸收—再氧化 + 蒸馏: Four oxidation-state steps: oxidize – blow out – absorb – reoxidize + distill
海水近中性，为什么一定要先加硫酸酸化？: Seawater is nearly neutral. Why must sulfuric acid be added first?
把酸化 pH 从 3.5 拖到 7（等于不加硫酸）: Drag the acidification pH from 3.5 to 7 (as if no sulfuric acid were added)
海水近中性，Br₂ 与 Cl₂ 都会歧化，溴白丢、氯白耗；酸化到 pH 3.5: Seawater is nearly neutral, so both Br₂ and Cl₂ disproportionate, wasting bromine and chlorine; acidifying to pH 3.5 keeps bromine as Br₂ molecules that can be blown out.
海水近中性，Br₂ 在碱性条件下歧化：Br₂ + 2OH⁻ = Br⁻ + Br: Seawater is nearly neutral, and Br₂ disproportionates under basic conditions: Br₂ + 2OH⁻ = Br⁻ + BrO⁻ + H₂O.
Cl₂ 在碱性条件下也歧化，等于白耗氯气。: Cl₂ also disproportionates under basic conditions, wasting chlorine.
酸化到 pH 3.5，溴以 Br₂ 分子存在，才容易被空气带走。: Acidified to pH 3.5, bromine exists as Br₂ molecules and is easily carried off by air.
去掉酸化：吹出率从 88.5 % 掉到 39.8 %。: Skip acidification: the blow-out rate drops from 88.5 % to 39.8 %.
考点：为什么先酸化再通氯气（抑制歧化、减少氯耗）。: Exam point: why acidify before adding chlorine (suppress disproportionation, save chlorine).
通氯气这一步，到底把溴变成了什么？: What exactly does the chlorine step turn the bromine into?
把通氯比从 0.6 拖到 1.1（理论量的 1.1 倍）: Drag the chlorine ratio from 0.6 to 1.1 (1.1 times the theoretical amount)
Cl₂ 氧化性强于 Br₂（卤族自上而下非金属性减弱），2Br⁻ + Cl₂ =: Cl₂ is a stronger oxidizer than Br₂ (non-metallic character decreases down the halogens): 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻, with Br rising from −1 to 0; chlorine is fed at 1.1 times the theoretical amount, and excess contaminates the liquid bromine with chlorine (purity 95.0 → 72.5 %).
Cl₂ 的氧化性比 Br₂ 强（同主族自上而下非金属性减弱），所以能把 Br⁻: Cl₂ is a stronger oxidizer than Br₂ (non-metallic character decreases down the group), so it can oxidize Br⁻.
Br 由 −1 升到 0，Cl 由 0 降到 −1，电子转移 2 mol / m: Br rises from −1 to 0 and Cl falls from 0 to −1, with 2 mol of electrons transferred per mol Br₂.
按理论量的 1.1 倍通氯；过量会让液溴带氯、纯度掉到 72.5 %。: Feed chlorine at 1.1 times the theoretical amount; excess contaminates the bromine with chlorine and purity drops to 72.5 %.
去掉氧化：Br⁻ 还是 Br⁻，后面一步也吹不出任何东西。: Skip oxidation: Br⁻ stays Br⁻, and the next step blows out nothing.
考点：离子方程式 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻，以及「氯气为什: Exam point: the ionic equation 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻, and "why chlorine can oxidize bromide ions".
溴已经变出来了，为什么要用大量空气把它吹走？: The bromine has been formed. Why blow it away with huge amounts of air?
把吹出塔空气温度从 40 ℃ 升到 80 ℃，看剖开的塔里气液怎样接触: Raise the blowing-out tower's air temperature from 40 °C to 80 °C and see how gas and liquid meet in the cut-away tower
Br₂ 沸点只有 58.8 ℃、极易挥发；海水加温到 80 ℃、空气按 300:: Br₂ boils at only 58.8 °C and is very volatile; seawater heated to 80 °C is stripped by air flowing upward countercurrent at an air-to-water ratio of 300:1, moving bromine from liquid to gas. At low temperature it won't blow out.
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃，是常温下唯一的液态非金属单质，极易挥发。: Br₂ boils at 58.8 °C; it's the only nonmetal element that's liquid at room temperature, and it's very volatile.
吹出是物理过程：溴从液相进入气相，价态仍然是 0。: Blowing out is a physical process: bromine moves from liquid to gas, with its oxidation state still 0.
加温到 80 ℃ + 气水比 300:1 逆流，吹出率才有 88.5 %。: Only with 80 °C + 300:1 countercurrent air does the blow-out rate reach 88.5 %.
去掉吹出：溴留在几万吨海水里，后面的富集无从谈起。: Skip blowing out: the bromine stays in tens of thousands of tonnes of seawater, and there's nothing to concentrate.
考点：吹出是物理变化，以及「为什么加热、为什么气量要大」。: Exam point: blowing out is a physical change, and "why heat it, why so much air".
吹出来的溴气那么稀，怎么变成能蒸馏的浓溶液？: The bromine vapor blown out is so dilute. How does it become a concentrated solution that can be distilled?
打开 SO₂ 吸收塔（先看关着时候的后果）: Turn on the SO₂ absorption tower (first see what happens with it off)
用 SO₂ 水溶液把 Br₂ 还原吸收：Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2: SO₂ solution reduces and absorbs Br₂: Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄ (Br 0→−1, S +4→+6); the absorbing liquid is only 1/300 the volume of the seawater, so bromine is concentrated 255 times. This step is the "concentration".
SO₂ 是还原剂，把 Br₂ 还原成 HBr 溶进水里。: SO₂ is a reducer, reducing Br₂ to HBr that dissolves in water.
Br 由 0 降到 −1，S 由 +4 升到 +6，电子守恒 2 mol e⁻: Br falls from 0 to −1 and S rises from +4 to +6, conserving electrons at 2 mol e⁻ / mol Br₂.
吸收液只占海水量的 1/300，溴浓度放大 255 倍。: The absorbing liquid is only 1/300 the volume of the seawater, concentrating bromine 255 times.
去掉吸收：溴随尾气排空，回收率归零，还污染大气。: Skip absorption: the bromine leaves with the exhaust, recovery is zero, and the air is polluted.
考点：吸收工段的方程式，以及「为什么这一步叫富集」。: Exam point: the equation for the absorption section, and "why this step is called concentration".
吸收液里是 HBr，怎么变回液溴并拿到手？: The absorbing liquid contains HBr. How do you turn it back into liquid bromine and collect it?
投用二次氯化与蒸馏（吸收液 → Br₂ → 液溴）: Bring the second chlorination and distillation online (absorbing liquid → Br₂ → liquid bromine)
吸收液再通氯气：2HBr + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2HCl（Br −1→0）: Chlorine is passed into the absorbing liquid again: 2HBr + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2HCl (Br −1→0), then distillation (Br₂ boils at 58.8 °C) separates it from H₂SO₄/water as liquid bromine; the whole process theoretically uses 2 mol Cl₂ and 1 mol SO₂ per mol Br₂.
二次氯化：Br 由 −1 回到 0，又得到 Br₂。: Second chlorination: Br goes from −1 back to 0, giving Br₂ again.
蒸馏靠沸点差分离：Br₂ 58.8 ℃，水 100 ℃，H₂SO₄ 难挥发。: Distillation separates by boiling point: Br₂ 58.8 °C, water 100 °C, H₂SO₄ barely volatile.
理论摩尔比 Cl₂ : SO₂ : Br₂ = 2 : 1 : 1，三段反应各转: Theoretical mole ratio Cl₂ : SO₂ : Br₂ = 2 : 1 : 1, with each of the three reactions transferring 2 mol of electrons.
去掉蒸馏：只有吸收液，拿不到产品。: Skip distillation: you only have absorbing liquid, no product.
考点：二次氯化的作用，以及「溴的沸点低」在分离上的应用。: Exam point: the role of the second chlorination, and using "bromine's low boiling point" for separation.
把溴回收率调到 ≥ 78 %、纯度 ≥ 93 %，并保持 15 s: Bring bromine recovery to ≥ 78 % and purity to ≥ 93 %, and hold for 15 s
达标横幅；越界走「3 秒倒计时 → 事故 → 复盘」: Pass banner; going out of range triggers "3-second countdown → incident → debrief"
把每一步的条件都落在区间里：pH 3.5、通氯比 1.05、吹出 85 ℃、气水: Keep every step's conditions within range: pH 3.5, chlorine ratio 1.05, blow-out 85 °C, air-to-water 350.
回收率 = 氧化率 × 吹出率 × 吸收率 × 蒸馏收率，一环掉链子全盘掉。: Recovery = oxidation rate × blow-out rate × absorption rate × distillation yield; if one link fails, the whole thing fails.
纯度由通氯比决定：过氯就让溴里带氯。: Purity is set by the chlorine ratio: over-chlorinating contaminates the bromine with chlorine.
温度、气水比、pH 三个条件互相牵制，要同时照顾。: Temperature, air-to-water ratio and pH constrain one another and must be balanced together.
去掉任一工段：要么没有产品，要么产品不合格。: Skip any section and you either get no product or an off-spec product.
考点：综合评价一套提溴方案（回收率、纯度、氯耗）。: Exam point: evaluating a bromine extraction scheme as a whole (recovery, purity, chlorine use).
吸收塔投用：溴被 SO₂ 还原吸收，开始富集: Absorption tower online: bromine is reduced and absorbed by SO₂, and concentration begins
吸收塔已切断：溴随尾气排空: Absorption tower shut off: bromine leaves with the exhaust
二次氯化与蒸馏投用：吸收液变回液溴: Second chlorination and distillation online: absorbing liquid turns back into liquid bromine
蒸馏已停：只有吸收液，拿不到液溴: Distillation stopped: only absorbing liquid, no liquid bromine
吹出率—吹出塔空气温度: Blow-out rate vs blowing-out tower air temperature
— 吹出率 · ○ 当前工况 · 70–90 ℃ 设定区间: — blow-out rate · ○ current setup · 70–90 °C set range
吹出塔温度骤降，吹出率掉了——把温度调回去: Blowing-out tower temperature dropped suddenly and the blow-out rate fell; set the temperature back
氯气严重过量：溴里带氯，装置要停下来: Severe chlorine excess: the bromine is contaminated with chlorine and the plant must shut down
海水提溴前先加硫酸酸化，主要目的是: Before extracting bromine from seawater, sulfuric acid is added mainly to
抑制 Br₂ 与 Cl₂ 歧化: Suppress disproportionation of Br₂ and Cl₂
近中性/弱碱条件下 Br₂、Cl₂ 都会歧化，酸化到 pH 3.5 才能让溴以: Under near-neutral/weakly basic conditions both Br₂ and Cl₂ disproportionate; only after acidifying to pH 3.5 does bromine exist as Br₂ molecules that can be blown out.
通入氯气后，溴元素的化合价: After chlorine is passed in, the oxidation state of bromine
2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻：Br 由 −1 升到 0，Cl: 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻: Br rises from −1 to 0, Cl falls from 0 to −1.
空气吹出溴这一步属于: Blowing out bromine with air is
溴由液相进入气相，价态不变，是物理过程；靠的是 Br₂ 沸点只有 58.8 ℃。: Bromine moves from liquid to gas with no change in oxidation state, a physical process that relies on Br₂ boiling at only 58.8 °C.
吸收工段中 SO₂ 的作用是: In the absorption section, SO₂ acts as
Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄：S 由 +4 升: Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄: S rises from +4 to +6, so SO₂ is the reducer.
「富集」主要发生在哪个工段？: In which section does "concentration" mainly happen?
吹出把溴从大量海水搬进空气，吸收再把溴搬进少量 SO₂ 溶液，浓度放大 255: Blowing out moves bromine from a large volume of seawater into air, and absorption moves it into a small volume of SO₂ solution, raising its concentration 255 times.
最后用蒸馏分离液溴，依据是: Liquid bromine is finally separated by distillation because
溴的沸点低（58.8 ℃）: Bromine has a low boiling point (58.8 °C)
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃，远低于水，加热蒸馏时先汽化，冷凝即得液溴。: Br₂ boils at 58.8 °C, far below water, so it vaporizes first when heated and condenses into liquid bromine.
氯气过量：液溴带氯: Chlorine excess: chlorine in the liquid bromine
按 1.85 倍理论量通氯: Chlorine fed at 1.85 times the theoretical amount
过量 Cl₂ 溶入溴相: Excess Cl₂ dissolves into the bromine phase
生成 BrCl 等，沸点与 Br₂ 接近: BrCl and similar form, with boiling points close to Br₂
按理论量的 1.05–1.2 倍通氯，用余氯表在线监控: Feed chlorine at 1.05–1.2 times the theoretical amount and monitor residual chlorine online
氧化塔出口设余氯报警，超限自动减量: Install a residual chlorine alarm at the oxidation tower outlet that cuts feed automatically when exceeded
液溴纯度在线检测，不合格回流重蒸: Test liquid bromine purity online and send off-spec product back for redistillation
氯气不是越多越好：过量的氯既浪费原料，又把杂质带进产品。: More chlorine isn't better: excess chlorine wastes raw material and brings impurities into the product.
目标：把 1000 m³/h 海水里的溴回收成合格液溴（回收率 ≥ 78 %、纯: Goal: recover the bromine from 1000 m³/h of seawater as on-spec liquid bromine (recovery ≥ 78 %, purity ≥ 93 %).
已回到参考工况：pH 3.5、通氯比 1.10、吹出 80 ℃、气水比 300、: Back to the reference setup: pH 3.5, chlorine ratio 1.10, blow-out 80 °C, air-to-water 300, absorption and distillation online
达标！溴回收率与纯度都在目标线以上: Passed! Bromine recovery and purity are both above target
